layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing, Optical Alignment, Data Density
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Control Room Grid (Density, Data Correlation, Scanability)
rules: Mobile-first responsive grids, always start with grid-cols-1
Containers with border must have p-6 or p-8 internal padding to prevent collision
Never center everything; left-align data, text, and inputs for better readability
Every pixel utilized in dashboards, ensure widgets stretch horizontally and vertically (h-full)

components.strategy: Shadcn UI customized for tactile, grounded look. Avoid generic SaaS aesthetic.
components.buttons: Flat background, rounded-md, subtle hover lift (-translate-y-[1px]), crisp edges.
components.cards: Neumorphism Tactile Variant - flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-stone-200), no drop shadow by default.
components.inputs: Flat borders, neutral background, sharp readability.
components.tables: Dense rows, left-aligned data, clear borders between rows, subtle bg-stone-50 hover state on rows.

icons.usage: Use Phosphor icons for data-dense tools and dashboard UI elements. Weight: regular or duotone.

interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements: explicit text color change and subtle bg transition.
Focus states strictly enforced for accessibility (ring-2 ring-stone-900 ring-offset-2).
Staggered entrance animations for dashboard widgets using framer-motion.

image_urls.description: Avatar for a client in the clients list
Abstract textural background for the login and registration page hero/side panel

rules: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
Maintain strict contrast ratios for text visibility (APCA > WCAG).
Use explicit hover/focus state colors. Never rely solely on inheritance.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read /app/design_guidelines.json completely before writing any code.
Ensure global CSS imports fonts (Outfit & IBM Plex Sans) via Google Fonts.
Configure Tailwind config (tailwind.config.js) with custom font families and stone/emerald/rose color palette.
Implement Shadcn UI, but override defaults to match the organic, flat, bordered aesthetic (remove large drop-shadows on cards).
Use Phosphor icons exclusively, executing the install command first.
Implement dashboard layout using strict CSS grid or bento grid concepts ensuring widgets align cleanly.
Ensure multi-currency toggle updates state universally without breaking layout.
Use Recharts or Shadcn Charts for financial metrics, styled with the emerald/rose palette.
Apply the Auth Hero image in a split-screen layout for the login/register flows.
Never use placeholders for images; use the links provided in this JSON.
Use data-testid on every clickable button, link, and major block for robust testing.
